seo.title: Video consultations — Alder Health
seo.description: How an example video consultation works at Alder Health: choosing video when you book, what you need beforehand, and what to expect on the day.

intro.title: Video consultations.
intro.lead: Choose video in the visit selector to explore example video availability, and talk to a clinician without travelling.

image.alt: A laptop open on a desk beside a window, set up for a video consultation.

hero.caption: Illustrative photography, not a patient story.

about.heading: A conversation, wherever you are.
paragraphs: Alder brings outpatient appointments and video consultations together, so you can choose the right setting for your day.
The clinic can help you check whether a video consultation is suitable for your visit. Some appointments are better in person, and the team will say so.

items.title: Choose a clinician
items.copy: Browse the example clinicians and filter by visit type to see who offers video.

items.title: Pick video and a time
items.copy: Select video in the visit selector, then choose from the example availability shown.

items.title: Review the details
items.copy: Check the clinician, time and visit type before you confirm the appointment.

items.title: Join at your appointment time
items.copy: In a real service you would receive a link to join. This demonstration ends at the confirmation screen.

items.title: A suitable device
items.copy: A phone, tablet or computer with a working camera and microphone.

items.title: A private place to talk
items.copy: Somewhere quiet where you are comfortable discussing your health.

items.title: Your questions ready
items.copy: Have a list of questions and relevant appointment documents ready, as you would for an in-person visit.

faq.heading: Good to know.
faq.supporting: Need something else? Our example support team is a good place to start.

next.eyebrow: Your next step, at your pace
next.heading: Book a video visit.
next.copy: Choose a clinician, pick a time, and review the details before you confirm.

notice.title: Not an operational service
notice.copy: No video consultation is provided through this site. There is no booking service, patient portal or consultation platform behind these screens — they exist to demonstrate the design.
